name: Original palace — delicate platform supports
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Exactly4 large cells, large three-quarter view for each module plus small front, top and side/contact/section diagram consistent with same geometry. Real open doors/arches/windows must show empty space; no opaque filling where an opening is requested. Continuous unobstructed planar joining ends, separate shells from optional decor, no fused unrelated objects. Hollow roof/room sections show the interior underside and wall thickness. Keep source silhouette, not generic boxes. Title "PAL-SKY-SUPPORT-001 — Original palace — delicate platform supports". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".

Purpose/gap: Missing independently supported limited platforms and pillar interconnections; preserve castle silhouette

PAL-SKY-SUPPORT-001-S01 — Slender pillar and capital support bay. Dimensions W,D,H [8, 8, 25]m proposed. One isolated slender pillar and capital support bay with slender ivory/rose marble columns, gold collars and realistic visible contacts. Show structural section and joining sockets; no full bridge network or extra castle towers. Supporting pillars thin relative to giant architecture, landing modest.

PAL-SKY-SUPPORT-001-S02 — Branched platform underside bracket. Dimensions W,D,H [8, 8, 25]m proposed. One isolated branched platform underside bracket with slender ivory/rose marble columns, gold collars and realistic visible contacts. Show structural section and joining sockets; no full bridge network or extra castle towers. Supporting pillars thin relative to giant architecture, landing modest.

PAL-SKY-SUPPORT-001-S03 — External tower side landing connection. Dimensions W,D,H [8, 8, 25]m proposed. One isolated external tower side landing connection with slender ivory/rose marble columns, gold collars and realistic visible contacts. Show structural section and joining sockets; no full bridge network or extra castle towers. Supporting pillars thin relative to giant architecture, landing modest.

PAL-SKY-SUPPORT-001-S04 — Two level pillar cross connection. Dimensions W,D,H [8, 8, 25]m proposed. One isolated two level pillar cross connection with slender ivory/rose marble columns, gold collars and realistic visible contacts. Show structural section and joining sockets; no full bridge network or extra castle towers. Supporting pillars thin relative to giant architecture, landing modest.
